text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Japan Cup, the crowd's 
expectations rested on Kitasan Black and 
Satono Crown. But Vivlos's family's faith 
in her never wavered.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos and Cheval Grand also believe in 
each other's strength and recognize it 
from the bottom of their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having received heartfelt encouragement 
from her Trainer, Vivlos headed into the 
Japan Cup brimming with confidence!
